name: Install JWKS Refresh On-Start
description: Installs an on-start drop-in that fetches the Zitadel JWKS (RS256) to /jwks/jwks.json for PostgREST (PGRST_JWT_SECRET=@/jwks/jwks.json) and signals a config reload on key rotation. Runtime half of the zitadel-pgrst-auth integration; pairs with 331-provision-auth-rls. Optional: skipped unless the oidc stacktype provides ZITADEL_URL.

commands.description: Create JWKS refresh on-start drop-in script
